items.desc: nanoMuse: an open-source personal agent for every device you own — one agent with a name and a face that does things, keeps working while the app is closed, remembers you, and asks before anything you cannot undo. On Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows / macOS / Linux and in the browser; your phone's screen and your computer as its hands.
Rewrites AI drafts so they read like a person wrote them — runs locally, keeps the facts
